name: Aijima Noel
source: Noel boasts top-class racing skills as well as looks.... He is in no short supply of enthusiastic female fans and seems unstoppable. Noel spent his school years in Ireland, Switzerland, and England, and currently races with the AIJM team. He is a top racer on the international circuits..
